text:
Sara (Support): FYI customer QuillCare opened a high-priority ticket. They need streaming completions that can emit function-calls + final structured JSON schema to our webhook. Key ask: partial fncall events so downstream can start processing asap.

Lana (Sales): They mentioned 500 qps peak, 50 rps sustained, latency <200ms per chunk. It's an enterprise contract if we can guarantee delivery SLA.

Alex (Product): Questions: do they need resumable streams? webhook vs websocket? schema validation server-side? Can they accept a 'final' reconcile event?

Sara (Support): They prefer webhook push (HTTP SSE is ok). Want resumable resume token if connection drops. Yes to server-side schema validation and automatic rollback on schema mismatch.

Devon (Eng): Rough feasibility: streaming fncall + partial structured output requires series-level framing + event types. We currently stream tokens + final fncall; partial fncall events aren't implemented. Estimate: 3-4 wks design + 4-6 wks implementation incl SDKs + canary. Blockers: backwards compatibility for existing clients, ordering/duplication on reconnect, auth for webhook delivery.

Mike (SRE): Need delivery guarantees for webhooks: retry/backoff, DLQ, idempotency keys. Also observability hooks per-request for token usage tracing.

Alex (Product): Proposed acceptance criteria (very rough):
- API can stream intermediate fncall events with deterministic event types
- Resume support with token and idempotent replay
- Schema validation with clear error codes
- SDK support in Python/TS + docs
- Canary rollout with 1-2 customers, SLA test

Lana (Sales): Timeline request from QuillCare: 8 weeks max. Can we commit to a beta in 6 weeks?

Devon (Eng): 6 weeks is tight but maybe for beta if we scope to single model family and webhook only, no on-prem. Full rollout needs 10-12 wks.

Alex (Product): Tradeoff: Beta (webhook-only, single model family, best-effort retry) vs Full (webhook+ws, resumable across infra, DLQ). Decide scope for roadmap slot.

Sara (Support): Customer will accept beta if we provide safety controls + PII redaction hook.

Devon (Eng): PII redaction hook is additional work but can be implemented as configurable pre-delivery filter. +1 week.

Alex (Product): Ok, propose we scope roadmap card: "Streamed fncall partial events + structured final output (webhook beta)" with launch criteria above. Owner: @Devon. Target: beta in 6 weeks (webhook-only, single model family). Follow-ups: security review, SDK sprint, infra retry/DLQ.

ops-bot: Created backlog ticket INF-4723 and assigned to Devon.

Lana (Sales): Sending QuillCare the proposed beta plan now. :thumbsup: 

Sara (Support): Adding this thread to product triage board. @Alex please confirm before I mark as P0.

Alex (Product): Confirmed P0. I'll write acceptance criteria and link to INF-4723.

Devon (Eng): I'll kick off a draft RFC this week. Need input from SRE on webhook guarantees.

Mike (SRE): I'll scope retry windows and DLQ ops. Ping me for sizing.

Lana (Sales): Thanks team. Keeping customer updated.

Sara (Support): Closing loop here, will post customer acceptance when they sign off.

Sample event idea pasted by Devon (for clarity):
```
{
  "event": "fncall.partial",
  "request_id": "rq_abc123",
  "call_id": "call_01",
  "payload": { "step": 1, "partial": { /* partial JSON piece */ } },
  "resume_token": "tok_xyz"
}
```
